module Demo

import Data.Vect

{- outer {- nested -} still a comment -}
data Shape = Circle Double | Rect Double Double

area : Shape -> Double
area (Circle r) = 3.14 * r * r
area (Rect w h) = w * h

total
append : Vect n a -> Vect m a -> Vect (n + m) a
append [] ys = ys
append (x :: xs) ys = x :: append xs ys

interface Show' a where
  show' : a -> String

main : IO ()
main = do
  let c = 'x'
  putStrLn ("Hello, Idris!\n" ++ show (area (Circle 1.5)))
  printLn (Just 42, Nothing {a = Int}, True)
